needTitle: Let your chat colour the room.
needBody: Viewers spend channel points to change the colour of your Govee lights. I’ll help you connect them, one step at a time.
needNoteBody: A Govee Home account, and Govee lights already set up in the Govee Home app. Lights that only use Bluetooth may not show up.
keyBody: Govee gives out free API keys from the Govee Home app on your phone. Follow this path and fill in the short form.
keyEmailHint: Govee usually sends the key by email. If it does not arrive, check your spam folder.
keyOlderHint: A new key turns off any older key on your Govee account.
pasteBody: Copy the key from the Govee email and paste it below. We check it with Govee before you continue.
keyStored: Stored encrypted and never shown back.
lightsBody: Your key is saved. Next, give each light a channel points reward so viewers can change its colour.
devicesKeyRejected: Govee no longer accepts your API key. Choose Paste your key and paste a new key from the Govee Home app.
footer: A room your chat can colour.
